spec_match.rationale: Runs a real Profiler session at the spec's sampleInterval granularity under work chosen to hit the marker vocabulary (script burn, forced style+layout, canvas paint) and renders only what the returned ProfilerTrace contains.

interactive.rationale: The button runs a fresh 600ms session each time; meters and histogram rebuild from the new trace.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises a real session with an honest unmarked rendering; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles blocked construction, unmarked engines (dedicated unmarked-with-stack / unmarked-idle buckets), and disables the button during a run.

conformance.rationale: The suite's trace-shape and marker-vocabulary assertions run the same capture pattern.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP runs: real sessions captured 122–126 samples with correct stack counts and the honest all-unmarked histogram; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

design_system.rationale: Histogram bars are text-black on stone tracks (AA); CSS variables only; the offscreen canvas workload is fixed off-viewport.

accessibility.rationale: Meters and histogram are aria-live; bars carry textual counts; native button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Meter grid collapses under 640px; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Capture a marked histogram on isolated Chrome 153
openQuestions.detail: On a COOP/COEP-isolated origin with Chrome 153, the same induced workload should populate script/style/layout/paint buckets — capture that run to complete the story.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pair bars with textual values and keep a single-hue encoding for one measure.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every bar row carries its numeric count as text; bars are single-colour with length as the only encoding.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Bound synthetic load in per-frame slices so the page stays responsive.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Work runs in ~14ms slices between rAF ticks for a fixed 600ms window.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): real 600ms profiling sessions on this origin captured 120+ samples and rendered the honest unmarked histogram on Chromium 141. Marked-bucket verification needs isolated Chrome 153 and is recorded.
